landing.title: A beautiful digital menu your restaurant can launch today.
landing.intro: Build a bilingual, branded menu, share it with one QR code, and understand what guests love—without complicated hardware.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything needed to serve a modern menu
features: Publish Arabic and English content with true RTL and LTR layouts.
Choose themes, colors, logo, cover, and opening hours.
Generate a restaurant QR code and share one fast public URL.
See anonymous views, visitors, clicks, and popular dishes.
Guests can build a cart and send their selection through WhatsApp.
Organize categories and dishes from a focused owner workspace.
landing.benefitsTitle: Less friction for owners. Better browsing for guests.
benefits: Give every dish a clear, searchable home.
Learn which categories and items attract attention.
landing.pricingText: MenuOS is preparing its commercial plans. Join now to shape the right package for your restaurant.
faqs: No. Every menu opens in the browser from a link or QR code.
Can I use Arabic and English?
Yes. Restaurant, category, and item content supports both languages.
No. MenuOS stays focused on the digital menu and guest experience.
Can I change my theme later?
Yes. Branding and menu content can be updated whenever you need.

landing.finalText: Create your restaurant workspace and publish a polished menu in minutes.
